cadence.event_driven: after each manifest publish or refresh decision
cadence.quarterly: full restore drill with logged evidence

recovery_scenarios.name: manifest_corruption
recovery_scenarios.operator_action: quarantine corrupt manifest and restore latest valid lineage chain

recovery_scenarios.name: partial_backup_write
recovery_scenarios.operator_action: skip incomplete bundle and fall back to previous completed verified bundle

recovery_scenarios.name: metadata_deletion
recovery_scenarios.operator_action: restore only missing metadata subtree and validate lineage continuity

recovery_scenarios.name: replay_divergence
recovery_scenarios.operator_action: compare restored ledger fingerprint, pin to last known-good bundle, escalate if mismatch persists

operator_guardrails: all restore operations must stay under allowlisted roots
do not recover bulk datasets through metadata backup lane
freeze manifest publishes if latest two bundles fail integrity checks
